subject: Interview logistics: panel schedule & accessibility accommodations for Samir Kapoor
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@gmail.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-18T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Intro & scheduling — Redwood SWE interview (Samir)

Hi Samir — excited to confirm next steps. We’d like to schedule your on-site loop (virtual) for Tuesday, Nov 21. Below is the proposed itinerary — everything will run over Zoom and I’ve attached a draft agenda and your resume for the panel.

Proposed timeline (PT):
- 10:00–10:10 — Welcome + recruiter intros (Priya)
- 10:10–10:50 — System design (Ben)
- 11:00–11:30 — Deep dive / take-home discussion (Marissa)
- 11:30–11:50 — Culture & growth (Laura)
- 11:50–12:00 — Wrap + next steps

A few quick asks so we can finalize:
1) Do you need captioning or an ASL interpreter? If so, what are your preferences (live captions only vs ASL)?
2) Are you on PT November 21 mornings? If not, tell us a better window.

Attachments: [Attachment: samir_kapoor_resume.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: draft_agenda.docx (DOCX)]

Thanks — Priya
Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@gmail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-18T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro & scheduling — Redwood SWE interview (Samir)

Hi Priya / team — thanks for the invite. I can do the Nov 21 PT morning window. I do need an ASL interpreter for the loop, and I prefer having a human interpreter on the call rather than only auto captions. Live captions in addition are great.

A couple more notes: I’ll be joining from Vancouver (PT). My phone number if needed for on-the-day coordination is +1 (604) 555-0147. Also please share the Zoom link and any panel names ahead of time so I can prep.

Looking forward to it — Samir

On a related note, I attached my latest portfolio link here in case the panel wants to review ahead: https://samirk.dev/portfolio

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@gmail.com>
Date: 2028-11-18T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro & scheduling — Redwood SWE interview (Samir)

Thanks Priya — looping in Laura to lock the last interviewer. Samir — noted re: ASL interpreter + live captions, we’ll arrange both. Priya, can you confirm with TalentOps and get a booking confirmation? Prefer the interpreter to join 5 minutes before the candidate to set context, and we should make sure the Zoom host pins the interpreter for the candidate’s view.

Operational requests for the panel:
- Please keep the system design doc links minimal; we’ll ask Samir to share his screen only for the final 10 min if needed.
- Marissa, can you prepare one concrete follow-up question about distributed KV stores (10–15 min)?
- Laura, I’ll drop the interviewer short bios into the calendar invite once confirmed.

Also requesting a quiet room alternative for Samir in case the candidate would prefer a breakout with fewer participants during the culture conversation (rare but helpful). Priya — if TalentOps can provide interpreter + captioning, please include a short run-of-show for the interpreter so they know when to join and any breaks.

— Ben
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: TalentOps Ltd <talentops@talentops.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@gmail.com>
Date: 2028-11-19T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ASL interpreter booking — Samir Kapoor (confirmed)

Hi Priya & Ben — booking confirmed. Interpreter: Maya L. (ASL certified), joining as indicated below. We’ll provide live captioning via StreamCaption as a backup.

Interpreter schedule (PT):
- 09:55 — Maya joins Zoom meeting, brief with hiring host
- 10:00–11:50 — Live interpreting across sessions; 10-min micro-break at 11:00
- 11:50–12:05 — brief check-out and notes

Attachments: [Attachment: asl_booking_confirmation.pdf (PDF)]

If you want Maya to receive a one-page interviewer brief, send that file and we’ll deliver it securely before the session.
Best,
Liam Chen
Client Ops | TalentOps Ltd

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@gmail.com>, TalentOps Ltd <talentops@talentops.com>
Date: 2028-11-20T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final confirmations — Zoom link, final agenda & interpreter brief

All — finalizing everything for tomorrow. Calendar invite sent (PT 10:00 start) — link below. I’ve attached the final two docs: a 1-page interviewer brief for Maya and the final agenda. Please review quickly and flag anything urgent.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwoodloop
Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=0a1b2c3d4e5f

Final agenda snapshot (PT):
- 09:55 — Maya (interpreter) joins for 5-min handoff
- 10:00–10:10 — Welcome + quick logistics (Priya)
- 10:10–10:50 — System design (Ben)
- 11:00–11:30 — Deep dive + code discussion (Marissa)
- 11:30–11:50 — Culture & career (Laura)
- 11:50–12:00 — Close & next steps (Ben)

Attachments: [Attachment: asl_interpreter_brief.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: final_agenda.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: panel_list.csv (CSV)]

Samir — we’ll pin Maya so you see the interpreter by default. If anything changes on your end, reply here or call my cell +1 (415) 555-0199. Thanks team — see you tomorrow.

— Ben
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
